sections.overall: A far quieter week compared to the touching tribute shows we had in the previous one. Best match of the week was Darby Allin vs Myron Reed (7.63) on Collision; again the Saturday opener was the highest-rated show of the week!
sections.mens: Darby and Myron only had a minor gain, mostly due to the former's high rating. A ew other matches in the 6's, but no major surprises. The biggest letdown was Jon Moxley vs Zachary Wentz (4.72), a match neither man would have been likely satisfied this week, with the Continental Champ slipping several places.
sections.womens: Two Women's singles this week, and each one delivered. Lena Kross vs Alex Windsor (6.87) was the third best match overall across the week, though with fewer votes for Dynamite matches and the show this week, the gain was more modest. Welcome back to Thekla - a popular return and straight back in at #4! This was also Zayda Steel's best singles match so far (6.7).
sections.menstag: No straight up Men's Tag matches this week, though a few did feature in the 8 Man Tag opener on Dynamite, including a welcome return for FTR! Back in at #2, their rating gradually dropped between DoN '26 and now, though it keeps them way above all other teams other than The Young Bucks.
sections.womenstag: No Women's Tags this week, which is becoming a shame as the diivison sorely needs some representation.
sections.trios: Again, the Trios teams continue to feature in AEW, including a decent match between Brodido & Page vs Cassidy, O'Reilly & Strong (6.59). The star-studded Dynamite main event was a relative letdown, considering the talent involved.
